title: Composition law for structure-sheaf cohomology pullback
statement: For composable scheme morphisms f : X ⟶ Y and g : Y ⟶ Z and every n ≥ 0, structureSheafCohomologyPullback (f ≫ g) n = (structureSheafCohomologyPullback f n).comp (structureSheafCohomologyPullback g n).

proof.text: Apply the pointwise composition theorem to an arbitrary cohomology class and use extensionality of additive homomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Section 01F7 equation-functorial; reduced to pointwise composition
